Can I get some maintainer eyes on #40901? This is currently blocking a larger development of the small inductive dimension, and I'd also like to use this new typeclass for some work over at CGT.

The diff is pretty large, but most of it is just moving theorems around.
This keeps acquiring some gnarly conflicts, so I'd appreciate if we could get it over the line.
Can I get a quick review on #44617? It's a trivial splitting PR that takes care of the import issues that have been plaguing this other PR.
